_comment: Movies tracked by the site's discovery scrapers. Each entry represents ONE site movie (identified by `slug`) with optional per-source identifiers: `zineflixMovieId` (for scripts/discover_zineflix_shows.py — e.g. /movie/places/show-cities/Paradise/77 -> 77), `cinemaxxSlug` (film-page slug on cinemaxx.de, e.g. `the-paradise` for /kinoprogramm/{city}/film/the-paradise — enables scripts/discover_cinemaxx_shows.py). Presence of a field enables that source; omit to skip. title/genre/language/page are used when regenerating booking.html.
